Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 32546 of 2024
Applicant :- Sushant And 2 Others

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Jagdish Prasad Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rajesh Kumar Tiwari
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.

Heard Sri Jagdish Prasad Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Rajesh Kumar Tiwari,
learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and Sri Ramesh Kumar, learned A.G.A. for the State.
2. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking quashing of the charge sheet no.114 of 2022 dated 25.6.2022 as well as cognizance/summoning order dated 22.09.2022 and the entire proceedings of Case No.14069 of 2022 (State Vs. Sushant and others), arising out of Case crime No.0114 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Muzaffarnagar, pending in the court of Civil Judge (J.D.), F.T.C.,
Sushant And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 3 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180005772/
1 Muzaffarnagar.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants had earlier approached this Court by filing of the Application U/s 482 No. 19533 of 2024, which was disposed of vide order dated 26.6.2024 directing the parties appeared before the trial court for verification of the compromise.

Learned counsel for the applicants submits that in terms of the aforesaid order, compromise dated 15.5.2024 between the parties have already been verified by the trial court, vide order dated 23.08.2024.
4.

Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the instant proceedings are arising out of matrimonial dispute between the applicant no. 1 and the opposite party no. 2, which has been amicably settled between the parties and compromise has also been verified by the trial court vide order dated 23.08.2024.
Therefore, he seeks quashing of the entire proceedings of complaint case in terms of the compromise.
5. In view of the compromise between the parties, learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 do not oppose the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants.

6. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, since the parties have already settled all their disputes amicably out of the court during the pendency of the instant proceedings, therefore,
the instant application is allowed in terms of the compromise dated 15.05.2024, which has been duly verified by the trial court concerned vide order dated 23.08.2024.
7.

The entire proceedings of charge sheet no.114 of 2022 dated 25.6.2022 as well as cognizance/summoning order dated 22.09.2022 and the entire proceedings of Case No.14069 of 2022 (State Vs. Sushant and others), arising out of Case crime No.0114 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Muzaffarnagar,
pending in the court of Civil Judge (J.D.), F.T.C., Muzaffarnagar are hereby quashed in the light of the judgements of the Apex Court in Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab and Another : (2012) 10 SCC 303; Prabatbhai Aahir Alias Prabatbhai Bhimsinghbhai Karmur and others vs. State of Gujarat and Another : (2017) 9 SCC 641; Narinder Singh & Ors. vs. State of Punjab : (2014) 6 SCC 466 and B.S.Joshi and Other vs. State of Haryana and Another : (2003)4 SCC 67.
Order Date :- 3.10.2024 Mini (Anish Kumar Gupta,J.)
